title: File and Folder Management in Windows
description: Hands-on practice with creating, copying, moving, renaming, and deleting files and folders
objective: Students will master file and folder operations in Windows File Explorer including creating folder structures, copying, moving, renaming, deleting files, and using the Recycle Bin.

steps.title: Create a Folder Structure
steps.instructions:
In this step, you will create an organized folder structure on your Desktop.

**Open File Explorer:**
- Press **Windows + E** to open File Explorer
- Navigate to the **Desktop** folder (click Desktop in the left panel)

**Create the main folder:**
1. Press **Ctrl + Shift + N** to create a new folder
2. Name it `TechPath Project`
3. Press Enter
4. Double-click to open it

**Create subfolders inside TechPath Project:**
1. Press **Ctrl + Shift + N** — name it `Documents`
2. Press **Ctrl + Shift + N** — name it `Images`
3. Press **Ctrl + Shift + N** — name it `Backup`

**Create sub-subfolders:**
1. Open the `Documents` folder
2. Create two folders inside: `Personal` and `Office`
3. Go back to `TechPath Project` (click the back arrow or press Alt + Left)
4. Open `Images`
5. Create two folders inside: `Photos` and `Screenshots`

**Your structure should look like:**
```
TechPath Project/
├── Documents/
│   ├── Personal/
│   └── Office/
├── Images/
│   ├── Photos/
│   └── Screenshots/
└── Backup/
```

**CCC Exam Connection:** Ctrl + Shift + N creates a new folder. This shortcut is useful to remember.

steps.title: Create and Save Files
steps.instructions:
Now let us create some files to work with.

**Create a text file:**
1. Navigate to `TechPath Project\Documents\Personal`
2. Right-click on empty area > **New** > **Text Document**
3. Name it `my-info.txt`
4. Double-click to open it in Notepad
5. Type the following:
```
Name: [Your Name]
City: Bhopal
Course: CCC at TechPath Institute
Module: Operating System
Date: [Today's Date]
```
6. Press **Ctrl + S** to save
7. Close Notepad (click X or press Alt + F4)

**Create a second file:**
1. Navigate to `TechPath Project\Documents\Office`
2. Right-click > New > Text Document
3. Name it `office-memo.txt`
4. Open it and type:
```
To: All Staff
From: Manager
Subject: Meeting Schedule

There will be a team meeting on Monday at 10:00 AM.
Please bring your project reports.

Regards,
TechPath Institute
```
5. Save (Ctrl + S) and close

**Create a third file:**
1. Navigate to `TechPath Project\Documents\Personal`
2. Create a new text file called `study-plan.txt`
3. Type your CCC exam study plan (at least 5 lines)
4. Save and close

**You now have 3 files in your folder structure.**

**CCC Exam Connection:** Ctrl + S saves the current file. This is one of the most important shortcuts.

steps.title: Copy, Move, and Rename Files
steps.instructions:
Now let us practice the three most important file operations.

**COPY a file (Ctrl + C, then Ctrl + V):**
1. Navigate to `TechPath Project\Documents\Personal`
2. Click on `my-info.txt` to select it
3. Press **Ctrl + C** (Copy)
4. Navigate to `TechPath Project\Backup`
5. Press **Ctrl + V** (Paste)
6. You should now see `my-info.txt` in BOTH locations — the original stays

**Verify:** Go back to `Documents\Personal` — the original file is still there.

**MOVE a file (Ctrl + X, then Ctrl + V):**
1. Navigate to `TechPath Project\Documents\Office`
2. Click on `office-memo.txt` to select it
3. Press **Ctrl + X** (Cut) — notice the icon becomes slightly faded
4. Navigate to `TechPath Project\Documents\Personal`
5. Press **Ctrl + V** (Paste)
6. The file is now in `Personal` and REMOVED from `Office`

**Verify:** Go back to `Documents\Office` — the file is gone (it was moved).

**RENAME a file (F2):**
1. Navigate to `TechPath Project\Backup`
2. Click on `my-info.txt` to select it
3. Press **F2**
4. Type `my-info-backup.txt`
5. Press Enter

**Important difference:**
- **Copy (Ctrl+C)** = Original stays, duplicate is created
- **Move (Ctrl+X)** = Original is removed, placed at new location

**CCC Exam Connection:** Copy = Ctrl+C, Cut = Ctrl+X, Paste = Ctrl+V, Rename = F2. These are the most commonly tested shortcuts.

steps.title: Delete Files and Use Recycle Bin
steps.instructions:
Let us learn about deleting files and using the Recycle Bin.

**DELETE to Recycle Bin (Delete key):**
1. Navigate to `TechPath Project\Documents\Personal`
2. Click on `study-plan.txt` to select it
3. Press the **Delete** key
4. If a confirmation dialog appears, click **Yes**
5. The file disappears from the folder

**Find it in Recycle Bin:**
1. Go to the Desktop
2. Double-click the **Recycle Bin** icon
3. You should see `study-plan.txt` here
4. The Recycle Bin shows where the file was deleted from and when

**RESTORE the file:**
1. Right-click on `study-plan.txt` in the Recycle Bin
2. Click **Restore**
3. The file goes back to its original location (`Documents\Personal`)
4. Navigate to `Documents\Personal` to verify it is back

**PERMANENT DELETE (Shift + Delete):**
1. Create a new text file in `TechPath Project\Backup` called `temp-file.txt`
2. Type anything inside, save and close
3. Select `temp-file.txt`
4. Press **Shift + Delete**
5. A warning asks: "Are you sure you want to permanently delete this file?"
6. Click **Yes**
7. Check the Recycle Bin — the file is NOT there (permanently deleted)

**CCC Exam Connection:** Delete = goes to Recycle Bin (recoverable). Shift + Delete = permanently gone (NOT recoverable). This is one of the most frequently asked questions.

steps.title: Search, Select, and Review
steps.instructions:
Let us practice searching for files and selecting multiple items.

**Search for files:**
1. Open `TechPath Project` folder
2. Click in the **Search box** (top-right corner of File Explorer)
3. Type `my-info` and press Enter
4. Both `my-info.txt` and `my-info-backup.txt` should appear in results
5. Clear the search and try searching for `*.txt` — all text files appear

**Wildcard search:**
- `*` matches any characters: `*.txt` finds all text files
- `?` matches one character: `file?.txt` finds file1.txt, file2.txt, etc.

**Select multiple files:**
1. Navigate to `TechPath Project\Documents\Personal`
2. Click on the first file
3. Hold **Shift** and click the last file — all files in between get selected
4. Now hold **Ctrl** and click individual files — add/remove from selection
5. Press **Ctrl + A** to select ALL files

**View file properties:**
1. Select any file
2. Press **Alt + Enter** (or right-click > Properties)
3. Note the following from the General tab:
   - File name and type
   - Location (full path)
   - Size
   - Created and Modified dates

**Final review — Write down:**
1. How many files are in your `TechPath Project` folder (including subfolders)?
2. What is the absolute path to `office-memo.txt`?
3. What is the size of your largest text file?

**Show your completed folder structure and answers to your trainer.**

**CCC Exam Connection:** The wildcard `*` matches any characters. `?` matches exactly one character. Alt + Enter shows file properties.
